key_concepts: The Sun is the star at the center of the solar system that provides light and heat.
Planets are large, round celestial bodies that orbit the Sun.
Moons are celestial bodies that orbit around a planet.
Comets are cosmic snowballs made of ice, dust, and rock that orbit the Sun.
Asteroids are space rocks of different shapes and sizes that orbit the Sun.
The solar system has eight major planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Ur

Some planets have no moons, while others have many moons.
Planets differ in how long they take to rotate on their axis and revolve around the Sun.
